q1.explanationZh: strip 作名词“条；带状物”，a strip of paper“一张纸条”；作动词“剪成条状”。

q2.explanationZh: strive 不及物动词“努力；奋斗”，常用 strive for sth.、strive to do sth.。

q3.explanationZh: strong 形容词“强壮的；强烈的”，副词是 strongly。

q4.explanationZh: structure 名词“结构”，也可作动词“建造；组织”。

q5.explanationZh: struggle 名词、动词同形，“斗争；挣扎”，注意双写 g。

q6.explanationZh: student“学生”，由 study 变来，注意拼写 stu-dent。

q7.explanationZh: studio“工作室；演播室”，复数直接加 -s：studios。

q8.explanationZh: study 可作名词和动词，“学习；研究”，第三人称单数 studies。

q9.explanationZh: stuff 名词“东西；材料”，动词“把……塞满”，结尾是两个 f。

q10.explanationZh: stupid 形容词“愚蠢的；笨的”。

q11.explanationZh: style 名词“风格；式样”，注意中间是 y，形容词 stylish“时髦的”。

q12.explanationZh: 前缀 sub-（在……之下）+ conscious（有意识的）= subconscious“潜意识的”。

q13.explanationZh: subject 名词“学科；主题”，动词“使遭受”，常用 be subjected to。

q14.explanationZh: subject 加 -ive 构成形容词 subjective“主观的”。

q15.explanationZh: submit“提交；屈服”，过去式 submitted 要双写 t。

q16.explanationZh: subscribe“订阅；认购；捐款”，常用 subscribe to / subscribe for。

q17.explanationZh: subsequent 形容词“随后的；继……之后的”。

q19.explanationZh: substantial 形容词“大量的；重大的”，结尾是 -tial。

q20.explanationZh: substitute 动词“用……代替”，名词“代替物”，substitute A for B“用 A 代替 B”。

q21.explanationZh: suburb“市郊”，常用复数 the suburbs。

q22.explanationZh: sub-（在下面）+ way（路）= subway“地道；地铁”。

q23.explanationZh: succeed 不及物动词“成功”，常用 succeed in (doing) sth.。

q24.explanationZh: success 是 succeed 的名词形式“成功”。

q25.explanationZh: success 加 -ful 构成形容词 successful“成功的”，只有一个 l。

q26.explanationZh: such 修饰名词“这样的；如此的”，such a/an + 形容词 + 名词。

q28.explanationZh: sudden 形容词“突然的”，副词 suddenly。

q29.explanationZh: suffer 及物动词“遭受”，suffer from“患病；受……之苦”。

q30.explanationZh: suffer 加 -ing 构成名词 suffering“痛苦，苦难”。

q31.explanationZh: sufficient 形容词“充足的，足够的”，注意 -ffi- 和 -cient。

q32.explanationZh: sugar“糖”，一般不可数，指“一份糖”时可数。

q33.explanationZh: suggest“建议；暗示”，注意 sugg- 双写 g。

q34.explanationZh: suggest 加 -ion 构成名词 suggestion“建议”。

q35.explanationZh: suit 动词“适合”，名词“（一套）衣服”，形容词 suitable。

q36.explanationZh: succeed in sth./doing sth.“在……上取得成功”，in 后接名词或动名词。

q39.explanationZh: strive for sth.“为……而奋斗”，for 表示目标。

q41.explanationZh: strive with/against“与……抗争”，with 和 against 都可以。

q42.explanationZh: rules of sentence structure“句子结构的规则”，rule 用复数。

q43.explanationZh: struggle/fight against“与……斗争”，against 表示“对抗”。

q44.explanationZh: struggle/fight for“为……奋斗”，for 表示目的。

q46.explanationZh: suggest 后接动名词：suggest doing sth.，不用 suggest to do。

q47.explanationZh: out of style“过时的，不时髦的”，反过来 in style“时髦地”。

q48.explanationZh: the subconscious self“潜意识的自我”。

q49.explanationZh: substitute A for B“用 A 代替 B”。

accept: go to the office by subway

q50.explanationZh: “乘地铁”用 by subway，by 后的交通工具不加冠词。

q51.explanationZh: relieve 后接名词作宾语，“减轻痛苦”用 suffering。

q52.explanationZh: “岗位不适合他”用 suit；主句是过去时，从句用过去式 suited。

q53.explanationZh: very 后接形容词，九十多岁还常散步，说明身体 strong“强壮的”。

q54.explanationZh: mean doing“意味着做……”，“拼命去找停车位”用 struggling。

q55.explanationZh: no 后接名词，be no substitute for“不能代替……”。

q56.explanationZh: further one’s study“继续深造”，his 后用名词 study。

q57.explanationZh: win success“取得成功”，win 后接名词 success。

q58.explanationZh: may 后接动词原形，subscribe for shares“认购股份”。

q59.explanationZh: can 后接动词原形，substitute A for B“用 A 代替 B”。

q60.explanationZh: suffer from“患（病）”；陈述一般情况、主语复数，用原形 suffer。

q61.sampleAnswer: A balanced diet and sufficient sleep help people maintain good health.
references: A balanced diet and sufficient sleep help people maintain good health.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “充足的睡眠”= sufficient sleep；“有助于某人做某事”= help sb. (to) do sth.。

q62.sampleAnswer: Are students who study in high schools free to choose their favourite courses?
references: Are students who study in high schools free to choose their favourite courses?

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: 用定语从句 who study in high schools 修饰 students；“可以自由做某事”= be free to do sth.。

q63.sampleAnswer: It’s up to you to decide whether to follow the fashion or dress in your own style.
references: It’s up to you to decide whether to follow the fashion or dress in your own style.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “由你决定”= It’s up to you to decide；“穿出自己的风格”= dress in one’s own style。

q64.sampleAnswer: Whatever stage of life you are at, it is a happy thing to be able to strive hard for the goal you pursue.
references: Whatever stage of life you are at, it is a happy thing to be able to strive hard for the goal you pursue.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “为……奋斗”= strive for；“无论哪个阶段”用 whatever 引导让步状语从句。

q65.sampleAnswer: I noticed that just after one month, she got ahead of her classmates by studying hard.
references: I noticed that just after one month, she got ahead of her classmates by studying hard.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “靠刻苦学习”= by studying hard，by 后接动名词；“名列前茅”可译为 get ahead of one’s classmates。

q66.sampleAnswer: He is very arrogant, so he is subjected to criticism.
references: He is very arrogant, so he is subjected to criticism.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “遭受，招致”= be subjected to，to 是介词，后接名词 criticism。

q67.sampleAnswer: They will only triumph by persevering in their struggle against natural calamities.
references: They will only triumph by persevering in their struggle against natural calamities.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “与……搏斗”= struggle against；“坚持……”= persevere in。

q68.sampleAnswer: Operation is one of the most effective ways to treat patients suffering from heart trouble.
references: Operation is one of the most effective ways to treat patients suffering from heart trouble.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: “患心脏病的病人”= patients suffering from heart trouble，现在分词短语作后置定语。

q69.sampleAnswer: The teacher suggests that all the students should learn how to use/look up words in a dictionary.
references: The teacher suggests that all the students should learn how to use/look up words in a dictionary.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q69.explanationZh: suggest 作“建议”时，that 从句用 (should) + 动词原形。

q70.sampleAnswer: Even if she finally failed in the exam, she maintained that this post was worth striving for.
references: Even if she finally failed in the exam, she maintained that this post was worth striving for.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q70.explanationZh: “值得做某事”= be worth doing，strive for 中的 for 不能丢。
